title: One sharp: F sharp
summary: A sign at the start that changes every F.

steps.title: Sharps at the start
text: A **sharp** raises a note by one fret. A sharp at the start of every line, on the F line, is a **key signature**.
It makes every F in the piece **F sharp**, with nothing written beside the note.

steps.title: Three F sharps
text: Open position has three: the 4th fret of the 4th string, the 2nd fret of the 1st string, and the 2nd fret of the 6th.
The one key signature covers them all.

steps.title: Up to G and back
text: Check the start of the line before you play: one sharp. The F near the top is the 2nd fret.

steps.title: F sharp on the 4th string
text: Now the lower F sharp: 4th fret, 4th finger.
